cc:Work.dc:title: 100,000-row SQLite comparison: ten workloads and eight execution paths
cc:Work.dc:description: Median and observed min/max of three measured samples. All axes start at zero with independent scales. SUM/COUNT and full scan use milliseconds; other workloads use microseconds. Data from measurements/dynamic-prepare-large-current.json.
